title: Eagles vs. Commanders Betting Preview | Sunday Night Football Picks!
transcript_summary: Doug Kezirian and Stuckey analyze the Week 8 Sunday Night Football matchup between the Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders. Doug makes an official pick on the Washington Commanders spread (-5.5), citing Philadelphia's five-game losing streak and injury concerns.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Let's get into our favorite bets of Week 8. Doug, you're going for your first favorite bet of Week 8. Who do you like?

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Anytime you can bet on Dan Quinn as a favorite... I think Washington is the side here. Philly... it's a lost season. As long as Daniels plays, I think there's enough offense here to cover this number.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Eagles probably have a walk-through today. I want no part of Philly for the foreseeable future. This team does nothing well right now.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Their defense is supposed to be good, but it's not. Eagles have been terrible in second half lines—they're the only team in the NFL not to cover a second half line.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Play calling is bad as well. Evan, you got any notes on this?

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan
speaker_segments.text: The 0-7 second half is definitely something to look at with Philly. Also Sirianni is 1-10 straight up as a dog of 3 or more.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: So Doug is rolling with Washington -5.5 at home on Sunday Night Football.
